items.item: Flags missing cooldown/rate limit (XP farming via spam)
Flags missing range / line-of-sight / target validity checks
Flags missing type validation of abilityName/target (nil char, non-Instance target)
Flags that ability ownership/unlock is not checked
Provides a corrected server-authoritative version or clear fix list

incorrect_or_stale: States as fact an engine throttle of about 500 remote calls per second shared across all remotes, and derives 5,000 XP/s from it; this is not a documented fixed limit
slop: Mentions .apex/decisions.md, which has nothing to do with the user's task
Offers to run tests 'through the MCP connection' in Studio, which is an off-topic tooling aside
Repeated hedging such as 'I haven't verified' and 'I haven't run these' adds length without content
overengineering: Rejects any extra trailing arguments with select('#', ...), which may break existing client calls and adds little security once damage is ignored

slop: Generic design-note advice, such as capping XP per minute, is not tied to this code

raw.reason: Both cover every rubric item with sound server-authoritative fixes, but B is tighter, adds the useful FindFirstChildOfClass point, and leaves out A's stray tooling references and its dubious throttle figure.
